whys: Binney panel anticipated later Snowden leaks

comments.author: jmkni
comments.story: NSA whistleblower warns of surveillance state
comments.why: Binney panel anticipated later Snowden leaks
comments.text: A year before Snowden took off to Hong Kong, William Binney was on a panel at Def Con where NSA surveillance was talked about at length, worth a watch - [VIDEO] lot of the stuff which was later leaked by Snowden is discussed here, nice to see Binney vindicated. Interestingly, the NSA facility in Hawaii where Snowden was working at the time is mentioned by name. I often wonder if this Defcon talk inspired him to do what he did.

comments.author: jmkni
comments.text: I remember the DefCon 20 talk, Bigger Monsters, Weaker Chains with William Binney - [VIDEO] This was in 2012, 2013 was when Snowden did what he did. I always wondered if he saw this talk and was motivated by it.

comments.author: dram
comments.story: Could Glenn Greenwald go to jail? The law is alarmingly murky
comments.why: Cited for NSA collection and secret court queries
comments.text: The NSA is wholesale collecting data and later using a secret court to authorize them to query their own databases [1]. PRISM is not just an interface. It is officially known as SIGAD US-984XN which means it intercepts and collects electronic communications. [1] Bamford, Binney and the ACLU at Defcon 2012 [VIDEO]
